name: Dense Berry Shrub
descriptions: A tangled, salt-sprayed shrub common along the coastal hiking trails.
The thick, woody stems create deep, shadowed pockets near the base, perfect for catching windblown debris.

name: Weathered Coastal Shrubbery
descriptions: A dense, salt-sprayed flowering shrub growing near the hiking trail.
Its thick, tangled branches create numerous dark gaps and hollow centers near the base.
Perfect for small things to get lost in among the dried petals and coastal debris.

name: Weathered Coastal Trellis
descriptions: A heavy, salt-crusted wooden trellis leaning against a seaside cottage wall.
Thick, woody vines of creeping jasmine have wound themselves tightly through the lattice, creating deep, shaded gaps in the wood.
Small crevices between the damp wood and the stone wall offer plenty of hiding spots for lost items.

name: Ancient Coastal Redwood
descriptions: A massive, towering redwood tree with thick, textured bark.
The needles shimmer slightly with sea salt spray.
Its roots stretch deep into the sandy, coastal soil, providing a stable landmark for hikers.

name: Ancient Crooked Pine
descriptions: A weathered pine tree with a dramatic, wind-swept bend.
Its bark is thick and salty from the coastal breeze.
A popular landmark for hikers navigating the coastal trails.

name: Verdant Coastal Pond
descriptions: A secluded, crystal-clear freshwater pond nestled within the coastal hiking trails.
Lush aquatic vegetation weaves through the depths, swaying gently in the stillness.
narrative_drinking: You cup your hands, bringing the cool, pristine liquid to your lips; it tastes of nothing but pure, refreshing clarity.
A swallow of the pond's water sends a soothing, revitalizing chill running down your throat.
The water is crisp and light, washing away the dust of the hiking trail with every sip.
narrative_wash_self: You plunge your hands into the cool depths, feeling the silky texture of the water as you rinse away the grit of the trail.
As you splash the water onto your face, the refreshing chill snaps your senses awake.
You wade into the shallows, letting the gentle movement of the water scrub your tired limbs.
meditation_aid_ambience: The rhythmic, soft lapping of water against the sandy banks creates a natural metronome for deep breathing.
The gentle rustle of aquatic plants provides a soothing, white-noise backdrop for quiet reflection.

name: Weathered Driftwood Log
descriptions: A massive, sun-bleached log washed up from the coast and partially embedded in the sandy soil.
Smooth to the touch from years of salt spray and sand abrasion.
The deep grooves in the wood provide numerous small nooks and shadowed crevices.
narrative_sitting: You lower yourself onto the sun-warmed wood, feeling the coarse, salt-crusted texture against your palms.
As you settle onto the log, the uneven surface forces you to adjust your weight, finding a momentary balance amidst the coastal breeze.
The heat of the day lingers in the thick timber beneath you, providing a steady warmth as you rest your tired legs.

name: Small Square Window
descriptions: A small, cozy square window framed in dark, polished wood.
The glass is beautifully fragmented by intricate wooden diamond-patterned grilles.

toggle_state.on_description: The window shutter is open, revealing the world outside through the diamond grilles.
toggle_state.off_description: The window shutter is closed, blocking the view with dark wood.
toggle_state.on_sequence: You slide the heavy wooden latch aside and push the pane open, letting in a fresh breeze.
toggle_state.off_sequence: You pull the wooden shutter closed, hearing the satisfying thud as it meets the frame.

name: Bundle of Dried Sea Grass
descriptions: A small, tightly bound bunch of salt-crusted grass collected from the coastal dunes.
Fragile and slightly abrasive to the touch.

name: Small Tuft of Coastal Grass
descriptions: A small, hardy clump of grass common in coastal rural areas.
The blades are slightly salty to the touch.

name: Tall Coastal Shrub
descriptions: A hardy, salt-tolerant shrub with dense, waxy green leaves.
Commonly found along the hiking trails of the coastal outskirts.

name: Coastal Ground Cover
descriptions: A patch of hardy, salt-tolerant vegetation clinging to the sandy soil.
Commonly found along hiking trails in coastal rural areas.

name: Large 'Francine' Bed
descriptions: An opulent, oversized bed featuring ornate dark wood carvings.
Draped in luxurious, deep purple silk sheets that shimmer in the light.
The mattress is incredibly plush, feeling as though it's filled with a cloud of soft feathers.
narrative_sleeping: You sink deep into the feather-soft mattress, the purple silk feeling cool and smooth against your skin as the world drifts away.
The massive bed swallows you up in a cloud of comfort, providing a sense of absolute security and warmth.
As you lie back, the plush mattress contours perfectly to your body, making you feel weightless amidst the heavy velvet textures.
narrative_sitting: You settle onto the edge of the bed, feeling the luxurious dip of the mattress beneath you.
The soft purple sheets bunch slightly under your weight as you find a comfortable position on the plush surface.
You rest on the edge of this grand piece of furniture, feeling the decadence of the Victorian craftsmanship beneath your hands.

name: Ornate Mahogany Vanity
descriptions: A massive, heavy-set vanity crafted from deep, dark-stained mahogany.
The piece features elegant cabriole legs and intricate, hand-carved floral flourishes along the apron.
Its surface is polished to a mirror-like sheen, reflecting the dim light of the room.
The many small gaps between the drawers and the carved edges create deep, shadowed crevices.

name: Ornate Mahogany Four-Poster Bed
descriptions: A massive, antique bed crafted from deep, dark-stained mahogany.
The frame features intricate hand-carved flourishes and sweeping cabriole legs.
The surface is polished to a mirror-like sheen, reflecting the dim light of the room.
It is dressed in luxurious, heavy purple sheets over a thick, yielding mattress.
narrative_sleeping: You sink into the plush mattress, the weight of the heavy purple sheets providing a comforting, cocoon-like warmth.
As you lie back, the grandeur of the dark timber frame fades into the background, leaving only the softness of the bedding against your skin.
The deep violet fabric feels cool at first, then quickly warms to your body as you drift toward sleep.
narrative_sitting: You sit on the edge of the bed, feeling the sturdy support of the mahogany frame beneath you.
The silkiness of the purple sheets brushes against your legs as you settle onto the soft mattress.
You rest against the cushioned headboard, surrounded by the scent of aged wood and polished lacquer.

name: Ornate Silk-Upholstered Rocking Sofa
descriptions: An oversized, grand rocking sofa crafted from deep, dark-stained walnut.
The frame features exquisite hand-carved flourishes and sweeping cabriole legs that taper elegantly toward the floor.
Luxurious heavy silk cushions cover the seat, offering a soft contrast to the mirror-like sheen of the polished wood.
The rhythmic creak of the heavy timber rockers promises a soothing rest.
narrative_sitting: You settle into the plush silk, feeling the weight of the heavy walnut frame stabilize your movement.
As you sit, the sofa gently oscillates, the polished wood runners gliding smoothly across the floor.
The ornate carvings press slightly against your hands as you grip the armrests, grounding you in the sofa's massive presence.
narrative_sleeping: You stretch out across the expanse of silk, the rhythmic, slow motion of the rockers lulling you toward sleep.
Wrapped in the warmth of the cushioned seat, you drift off as the dark, sturdy timbers sway with a hypnotic cadence.
The smooth, cool touch of the silk against your skin contrasts with the heavy, secure feeling of the mahogany-toned frame.

name: Pressure Oil Lamp
descriptions: A heavy, portable lamp crafted from hand-polished brass.
Features intricate filigree engravings around the fuel reservoir and a small, mechanical hand-crank for pressure regulation.
meditation_aid_ambience: The steady, rhythmic hiss of the pressure valve provides a grounding white noise.
A warm, golden luminescence dances against the room's textures, casting soft, elongated shadows.

toggle_state.on_description: The lamp emits a steady, amber glow through etched glass panes.
toggle_state.off_description: The brass casing sits cold and dark, reflecting only the dim ambient light.
toggle_state.on_sequence: You turn the small brass hand-crank, feeling the mechanical resistance of the internal pump. With a sharp hiss of pressurized air, a small flame blooms behind the etched glass, bathing your hands in sudden, comforting warmth.
toggle_state.off_sequence: You twist the shut-off valve; the rhythmic hiss tapers into a sigh, and the golden light retreats into a single, dying ember before vanishing into darkness.

name: Ornate Brass-Inlaid Circular Desk
descriptions: A heavy, dark mahogany desk with a circular top, featuring intricate brass filigree tracing the edges.
The underside is a labyrinth of hand-polished brass fittings and small, recessed gaps where dust and lost trinkets have gathered over decades.
A tarnished wrought iron support frame holds the heavy wood aloft, creating narrow crevices between the metal legs and the tabletop.

name: Brass-Filigree Bookbinding Station
descriptions: A heavy, industrial-grade workstation crafted from dark, oil-rubbed mahogany and reinforced with polished brass structural supports.
Features an integrated hand-cranked hydraulic press with etched glass viewing ports to monitor paper compression.
The surface is inlaid with intricate wrought iron filigree, providing a stable yet opulent space for delicate leatherwork.
Equipped with small, brass-fitted valves that control a steam-assisted drying tray, showing slight tarnishing around the edges from years of careful use.

name: Glyph-Etched Tide Rock
descriptions: A smooth, salt-crusted rock embedded deep in the coastal sands.
The stone pulses with a rhythmic, azure light that mimics the ebb and flow of the distant waves.
Faint, magical glyphs shimmer on its surface, forming an intricate, shifting labyrinth of light.
